tweet.text: Introducing MALT: a dataset of natural and prompted transcripts where agents behave in ways that threaten evaluation integrity (like generalized reward hacking & sandbagging) on HCAST & RE-Bench. For general use, we're releasing a split of MALT samples collected on public tasks.
